minor.issue: Pre-existing flaky overlap collision in test_richiedi_integrazione_e_reinvio (~10-20% failure on rerun) — uses random.randint(2700, 3000) which can collide with accumulated test data from prior runs. Passes reliably on retry. Not a code bug; test isolation only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grown to 776 lines — now exceeds recommended 700-line threshold; split by feature router (auth, spazi/pratiche, campagne, comune, admin) recommended before next iteration.

invia_campagna does not update pratica.pagamento with a per-pratica record — the campaign-level $set only sets `pagamento` once at the pratica level with `metodo/transazione_id/data` but omits `importo` (single-pratica checkout also sets importo). Consider setting per-pratica importo in the update_many for consistency with single-pratica checkout payload.
crea_campagna does _periodo_occupato in a serial loop (N spazi = N sequential Mongo queries); acceptable for small N but consider a single $or aggregation for larger multi-spazio campagne.
DateRangePicker anti-cross fallback in DateRangePicker.jsx uses `r.to > (value?.from || 0)` — comparing Date to number 0 works by JS coercion but is subtle; explicit null check would be safer.

CampagnaPlanner state race: `useEffect` re-fetches `/spazi/disponibili` on step/date/regione/tipologia change but does NOT abort in-flight requests; rapid filter changes can render stale results. Consider AbortController.

In Campagne.jsx STATO_COLORS lookup uses optional chaining fallback but if unknown stato appears (e.g., new lifecycle state added), backgroundColor becomes undefined → invisible chip. Add default color.

invia_campagna picks up pratiche with stato==BOZZA only — if user manually inviata one pratica separately then tries invia campagna, that one won't be re-processed but also won't error. Acceptable but could log/report.
